rows.ARS:
Dark red Floribunda.
Registration name: Abendglut™, POUlberg
Exhibition name: Valiant Heart™
rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, 1998). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, 1998).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S in 2000 as 'Abendglut'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. None to mild, mild fragrance. Small, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in large clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 2' to 39" (60 to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden.

rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Cants of Colchester say 'Valiant Heart' has large trusses of small deep red blooms. According to their Autumn 2000/Spring 20001 catalog, 50p from the sale of this rose goes to the Combined Police Benevolent Fund.
